children: Orchestra BioMed disclosed a slide presentation outlining AVIM Therapy and Virtue SAB pivotal programs, strategic funding of $185M+ and key 2027 trial and commercialization milestones.
Filed investor slide deck as Exhibit 99.1 describing AVIM Therapy and Virtue SAB programs and partnership model.
Company says strategic partners (Medtronic, Terumo, Ligand) provided >$185M in capital, supporting runway through 2027.
BACKBEAT pivotal trial for AVIM targets primary endpoint readout and enrollment completion in Q2 2027; potential FDA approval and Medtronic commercial launch if approved.
Virtue SAB pivotal randomized IDE trial (n=740) actively enrolling versus AGENT paclitaxel DCB, with 12-month TLF primary endpoint.
Orchestra emphasizes royalty-based, capital-efficient partnership model to drive global commercialization and uncapped double-digit royalties on AVIM-enabled devices.
